name: Buon Ma Thuot food guide
summary: Bún đỏ is the afternoon bowl on Le Hong Phong. Bánh ướt chồng đĩa is one hot sheet on its own plate. The highland meal is cơm lam, grilled yard chicken, and rượu cần. Published prices do not match. The price now is Check on arrival.
body: Start with coffee, black or with milk. At lunch, roll bánh ướt chồng đĩa on Trần Nhật Duật or Lê Thánh Tông. From about 15:00 or 16:00, Vietnam National Administration of Tourism puts bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong. The other meal is the one Bao Dak Lak calls the local set: sticky rice from a bamboo tube, yard chicken rubbed with lá ech, and a pull from the jar.

That set is Êđê and M’nông cooking. The Dak Lak provincial portal and Bao Dak Lak also name bitter eggplant, a soup pounded inside a bamboo tube, and forest greens. Da Lat’s charcoal pancakes are a different highland. Nha Trang is the coast. Stay when the red bowl and the jar are the meal.

The Dak Lak provincial portal says Tết tables run from grilled meat to jar wine, and does not name the animal. A cut is Check on arrival. Where a price or a sauce below disagrees, every figure stays. A figure with no current source is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism, the Dak Lak provincial portal, Bao Dak Lak, and VnExpress name these plates. Where a figure disagrees, every figure stays. A price with no current source is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Coffee
paragraphs: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cà phê as the drink of Buon Ma Thuot. The museum ticket on Nguyen Dinh Chieu is a separate gate.

spots.name: Coffee
spots.address: Nguyen Chi Thanh, Ako Dhong, and cafes through town
spots.note: Black or with milk. VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 prints 15,000 VND to nearly 100,000 VND, and a counter at the head of Bà Triệu that mixes the cup with ice cream. A current cup is Check on arrival. The World Coffee Museum prints 7:00–18:00 on its ticket list and 8:00–17:00 on its FAQ. An adult ticket is 150,000 VND. That is not the cup.

sections.heading: The red bowl and the stacked sheets
paragraphs: Bún đỏ is the afternoon specialty. Bánh ướt chồng đĩa is the self-rolled lunch. Nem nướng is the grilled paste VnExpress lists with them.

spots.name: Bun do
spots.address: Le Hong Phong, and also Phan Boi Chau, Phan Dinh Giot, Le Duan, and the night market
spots.note: Thick red noodles in a pork-and-crab broth. Vietnam National Administration of Tourism prints 15,000–30,000 VND and stalls from about 15:00 or 16:00, and says the color comes from hạt điều. VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 prints 20,000–35,000 VND. VnExpress on 21 Feb 2016 prints 20,000–30,000 VND. Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 prints no price. The price now is Check on arrival. The close, and a night-market clock, are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Stacked rice sheets
spots.address: Trần Nhật Duật and Lê Thánh Tông
spots.note: One hot sheet a plate. You add the grill and the pickle and stack the empties. Vietnam National Administration of Tourism names mắm nêm or a sweet-sour fish sauce and prints no price. VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names mắm nêm or mắm mặn and prints 25,000 VND for the meat and sausage plus 1,000 VND a sheet. VnExpress on 21 Feb 2016 prints about 30,000–50,000 VND a person. The price now is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled pork paste
spots.note: Grilled minced pork, sometimes on a lemongrass stalk, rolled in rice paper with herbs, green banana, and sour mango. VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 prints 30,000–50,000 VND and names Thanh Trầm, Thanh Loan, and Thanh Thủy, with no street. The price now is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Bamboo rice, chicken, and the jar
paragraphs: Bao Dak Lak on 29 Aug 2016 calls rượu cần, cơm lam, and gà nướng one set, and names Ko Tam in the city and Buon Tri A in Buon Don. Cá lăng from the Serepok is named with them and has no method.

spots.name: Bamboo sticky rice
spots.address: Ko Tam, Buon Ma Thuot, and Buon Tri A, Buon Don
spots.note: Sticky rice roasted in a fresh bamboo tube. The Dak Lak provincial portal says young lồ ô, rice, and water, on fire and charcoal. Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 says soak the rice overnight, add a little salt, and eat it with sesame salt or grilled pork or chicken. A street number for Ko Tam, the hours, and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled yard chicken
spots.address: Ko Tam, Buon Ma Thuot, and Buon Tri A, Buon Don
spots.note: Yard chicken given a few mouthfuls of jar wine, rubbed with pounded lá ech, and grilled so the skin goes golden without drying. The dip is salt pounded with lá ech, lá giang, culantro, scallion, and green chili. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jar wine
spots.address: Ako Dhong, and with the meal at Ko Tam or Buon Tri A
spots.note: Êđê wine from sticky rice and a yeast of galangal pounded with forest leaves. Bao Dak Lak on 30 Mar 2019 says a jar in Ako Dhong is drinkable after more than three months and better at a year, cloudy white, sweet, and fragrant. People pull the straws together. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Serepok catfish
spots.note: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cá lăng from the Serepok with the foods that start in Buon Ma Thuot. A cut, a method, a stall, and a price were not printed. They are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Bitter eggplant and forest greens
paragraphs: These are Êđê and M’nông plates from the Dak Lak provincial portal and Bao Dak Lak. Fresh fish, dried shrimp, forest meat, and frog stewed with bitter eggplant are named on the portal without a separate method. They sit with the soup, not as their own rows.

spots.name: Pounded bamboo soup
spots.note: Lá bép, rattan shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish or meat, cooked in a lồ ô tube and pounded with a chopstick. The Dak Lak provincial portal prints 60–90 minutes and says the soup finishes thick, bitter, hot, nutty, and fatty. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter-eggplant soup
spots.address: Stilt roofs in Buon Don, Lak, or the city
spots.note: Two soups stay. Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 pounds dried fish, fries it with onion and garlic, and thickens the pot with rice-washing water. The 24 Jun 2013 article uses beef offal and beef bung, then crushes the eggplant off the heat with lá é. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter-eggplant salad
spots.note: Thin eggplant, soaked, then mixed with fried dried anchovy, culantro, and a garlic-chili fish sauce. Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 names it with the soup as the best-known plates. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pounded bitter eggplant
spots.note: Raw fruit pounded with salt, chili, lá é, and scallion. The provincial portal calls it very hot and says it goes with a lot of rice. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled rattan shoot
spots.note: A bitter shoot from deep forest, grilled and dipped in salt pounded with xiêm chili. Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023. A stall and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cassava-leaf stir-fry
spots.note: Young cassava leaves and male papaya flowers stir-fried with steamed scad on a very low flame, in pork fat. Bitter, fatty, and hot. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Papaya with ant salt
spots.nameVi: Đu đủ giã muối kiến vàng
spots.address: Đường sách cà phê, for the tasting Bao Dak Lak reported
spots.note: Named at that tasting on 26 Jul 2023. A method beyond the name was not printed. The method and the price are Check on arrival. An everyday stall was not named.

spots.name: Djam tang soup
spots.note: A fine green from the Krông Ana, the Krông Knô, and the Serepok, cooked with stream fish. Bao Dak Lak on 24 Jun 2013 calls the soup sweet and nutty. A stall and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sour djam tang
spots.note: The same green, pickled sour, for dipping grilled meat and fish. A brine, a time, and a price were not printed. They are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Snakehead with ant eggs
spots.nameVi: Cá lóc canh chua trứng kiến
spots.address: Stilt roofs in Buon Don, Lak, or the city
spots.note: Sour snakehead soup with ant eggs, named by Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023. The souring agent was not printed. A method and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Stir-fried forest greens
spots.address: Stilt roofs in Buon Don, Lak, or the city
spots.note: Named in that same meal, with the bitter-eggplant soup and the bamboo rice. Which greens were not listed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mnong flour soup
spots.note: Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 names canh bột as a M’nông specialty and does not print a method. The method, a street, and a price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Market snacks
paragraphs: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names these three. Each printed price is that day’s figure. The price now is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fried sticky-rice cakes
spots.note: A sticky-rice shell. The rectangle has no filling. The round cake holds minced pork, wood-ear, and glass noodles. Fried crisp and cut small. The article prints 5,000 VND. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled honeycomb cake
spots.note: Sweet cake grilled until the sugar smells slightly burnt and bitter. The article prints 5,000 VND in the afternoon. Market hours and a stall number are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Beef in tamarind
spots.note: Thin beef dipped into sweet-sour tamarind on a hot pan. Brush butter, add sauce and onion, wait for a simmer, then dip. Dumping the pan at once toughens the beef. The article prints 150,000 VND a portion and calls the dish new in the years before 2021. Hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Regional dishes
paragraphs: These are Dak Lak plates Bao Dak Lak ties to another district. They are not the Buon Ma Thuot afternoon bowl. Drive minutes are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bronze-featherback cake
spots.note: Lak district. Pepper and fish sauce, then fried golden, with a few dill stems. Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021. A stall and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ea Kar chicken rice
spots.note: Rice from Coffee Farm 721, cooked in the chicken liquor, tinted with turmeric, and fried in chicken fat. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ea Sup mango
spots.note: Named as the district specialty, with forest bamboo shoots. A variety, a season, and a price were not printed. They are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest bamboo shoots
spots.note: Named with the mango. A preparation and a price were not printed. Both are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chicken mi quang
spots.note: Bao Dak Lak says the bowl has a taste found nowhere else, and does not print a method. This is not the Da Nang bowl. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Frog mi quang
spots.note: Named with the chicken bowl. How the frog is cooked was not printed. A method and a price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Three places to sit. None of them is a single dish. Clocks that were not printed are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Le Hong Phong bun do row
spots.nameVi: Phố bún đỏ Lê Hồng Phong
spots.note: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism says a row of bún đỏ stalls stands on this street from about 15:00 or 16:00. The close is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Central market
spots.note: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 puts bánh bò nướng here in the afternoon. A street number and the market hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ko Tam
spots.nameVi: Khu du lịch cộng đồng Kô Tam
spots.note: Bao Dak Lak on 29 Aug 2016 names this community tourism area for the jar, the bamboo rice, and the grilled chicken. A street number, the hours, and a price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 offers two breakfast bowls. It says hủ tiếu is not a local specialty. The morning drink is the coffee above.

spots.name: Pork-hock noodle soup
spots.note: Thin noodles, a lot of pork, a salty broth sweet from the meat, herbs, lime, garlic, and chili. The article prints 30,000–40,000 VND and no street. The price now is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hu tieu
spots.note: Saltier and less sweet than a southern bowl. Meat-and-bone, wonton, or Nam Vang. The article prints 15,000–25,000 VND and says this is not a Buon Ma Thuot specialty. The price now is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot food guide — bun do, bamboo rice, jar wine
seoDescription: Bun do on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00, stacked rice sheets, and bamboo rice with grilled chicken and jar wine. Published prices do not match. The price now is Check on arrival.
